device: iPhone 16 Pro, iOS 27.0.1, 402x874 pt; UIButton(.glass) 48x48 at center x, y 150, showsMenuAsPrimaryAction; menus open downward
source: deep dumps (tool/ios_reference/recordings/device-menuapi/dump-ml-*-open.txt, references/menu-api/*.png); motion fits from the frame rows in this directory

palette.selected_platter: rounded rect behind the selected cell (screenshot)

max_height.note: tall (30 rows) and SwiftUI menus both cap the menu view at 520 pt and scroll inside (indicator); not the safe area

layout.system_footer: the system appends a separated 'Ask Siri' row (pinned footer, 62 pt incl. its 20 pt gap) to every UIKit and SwiftUI menu on iOS 27.0.1 device

submenu.model: STACKED CARDS: the submenu is a new list that grows OUT OF its row (start 230 x 42 at the row) to 250 x content, over the parent; the parent list scales to 0.97 (250 -> 242.5) and its rows fade to alpha 0.5; the menu view grows to cover both
submenu.header: _UIContextMenuSubmenuTitleView 250 x 62 at the top of the submenu: the parent row title (bold) + chevron down + separator; tapping it goes back

open_deeper.note: third card; the first parent scales 0.97^2 (235.2), both parents alpha 0.5

hover_open.note: a held finger sliding onto a submenu row opens it 0.525 s after entering the row; sliding on and lifting on a sub row fires it 0.019 s after the lift

select_closes_all.note: a sub row's action closes the whole stack toward the source button (container h 287 -> 57)

live_updates.keepsMenuPresented: the handler runs (0.02 s after the lift) and the menu stays; UIKit does NOT redraw a check / palette selection / state change by itself (singleSelection Sort by and the palette kept the old mark) - the app must call contextMenuInteraction.updateVisibleMenu

resize_grow.source: mm-resize.jsonl (Add row via updateVisibleMenu), deferred load also 0.565/0.84

live_updates.swiftui: state-driven labels update live in place (Count 0 -> 2 with menuActionDismissBehavior(.disabled)); a Toggle row dismisses the menu

deferred.loading_row: spinner + 'Loading...' title in the disabled/secondary color, row height 42
deferred.load_resize: grows on 0.565/0.84 when the elements arrive

swiftui_mapping.Slider: section header with its label + two medium cells Decrement / Increment (117 x 51.67)
swiftui_mapping.Stepper: same as Slider: header 'Steps N' + Decrement / Increment cells
swiftui_mapping.ControlGroup: medium elements row (78 x 77, icon + 12 pt label)
